facts.text: The Radford Tuition Promise is funded through federal, state, and institutional gift aid so qualifying students are not required to take out student loans for tuition.

sources.title: Radford Tuition Promise | Radford University
sources.quote: Radford Tuition Promise is funded through federal, state and institutional gift aid. This means qualifying students will not be required to take out a student loan for their tuition cost.
